_note: SHARED MASTER bookmark repo (canonical). All sessions/worktrees read this one set via MC2_VISUAL_BOOKMARK_DIR pointed at this nifty tests/visual/bookmarks/ dir. Base poses = S9 v1 provisional (map-interior, stability-picked). The 6 oblique/topdown poses below are USER-AUTHORED (saved_view.txt 2026-07-02) from in-game [BOOKMARK v1] dumps. pos = [x,y,z] world units (z overridden to terrain elevation by setPosition land-follow). rot = cameraRotation deg, proj = projectionAngle deg, alt = camera altitude. Keep >=2 bookmarks (single-pose files silently fail).
